title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_o_pequeno_mas_muito_poderoso_livro_de_como_fechar_by_jeffrey_gitomer_184ll (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_o_pequeno_mas_muito_poderoso_livro_de_como_fechar_by_jeffrey_gitomer_184ll' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may result in full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different, uncompromised computer is strongly advised.
